items.title: [AINews] D-Day (Decision Models Day)
items.summary: 谷歌发布校准多模态决策模型Gemini Decision 1，支持单轮处理1000个问题及多种输入格式，端点延迟约150-250ms，输入成本每百万token仅0.10美元且输出免费，较Flash-Lite便宜约5倍，在多项基准测试中击败了TypeSafe的Jev 1.14。在独立评测中，该模型决策指数得分为66，与Elephant 9B及Jev 1.14持平，但略落后于Drex Max v1.1，其单任务成本345美元远高于Drex Max的103美元，且平均任务耗时211ms慢于Jev的92ms。
items.why_now: Gemini Decision 1刚发布，以$0.10/百万输入的低价提供200ms延迟，为独立开发者打开了低成本自动化决策窗口。
items.why_now_en: Google's new decision model undercuts rivals with 5x lower cost.
items.summary_en: Google launched Gemini Decision 1, a calibrated multimodal model designed for closed-set tasks like yes/no questions and multiple-choice scoring (up to 255 options), supporting up to 1,000 queries per request with a 256K context window and 150–250 ms latency. The model is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens with $0 output costs, claiming to be five times cheaper than Flash-Lite, and it outperforms TypeSafe's Jev 1.14 on five of seven shared benchmarks. Independent evaluations by Artificial Analysis show mixed results, with Gemini Decision 1 tying Jev 1.14 on the overall Decision Index (66) but significantly lagging behind Drex Max v1.1 on document accuracy (33% vs 63%) and cost-efficiency ($345 vs $103 per million tasks).

items.title: 刚刚，Gemini 4 新模型叒来了，终于人人可用
items.summary: 谷歌发布的高效率模型 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 在 Artificial Analysis 评测中智能指数达到 54 分，其速度较前代提升 2.5 倍，且幻觉率仅为 8%（对比 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的 43%），API 输入定价为每百万 Token 1.5 美元。该模型已接入 Google Search、Gemini App 等平台并对免费用户开放，配合新增的 Orchestrator 功能实现多模型自动分工，使任务完成速度提升 19% 且平均减少 24% 的额度消耗。
items.why_now: 谷歌免费开放Gemini 4 Hydrogen API，性能超旗舰但成本低，开发者即刻能白嫖。
items.why_now_en: Hydrogen API launched today, priced at 32% of Claude Sonnet 5.5.
items.summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, an efficient model that outperforms Gemini 4 Argon and rivals flagship models like Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol with an intelligence index of 54 in xHigh mode. It features up to 2.5x faster speed, an 8% hallucination rate, and a 1 million token context window, with API pricing set at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Hydrogen is now available to free users across Google platforms and includes a new Orchestrator feature that automatically assigns complex reasoning tasks to Carbon and execution tasks to Hydrogen, reducing resource consumption by 24%.

items.title: Edge0 开源 145B 端侧模型，可在笔记本本地运行
items.summary: Edge0-145B是全球首个可在个人电脑本地运行的1450亿参数开源模型，通过架构共享大矩阵、三存储层级流水线加载及CPU-GPU协同调度，实现了80+ tokens/s的推理速度，峰值内存仅占28GB。该模型在DeepSWE 1.1编程基准上得分64.6，显著超越Qwen3.8-Flash-Next等竞品，且内存占用仅为同等性能基线Qwen3.8-Flash-Next标准4-bit部署（约70GB）的40%，使得48GB内存笔记本即可离线执行复杂智能体任务。
items.why_now: Edge0今日开源145B模型，首破端侧百B级门槛，48GB笔记本可本地运行，即刻解锁零云费用私有智能体工作流。
items.why_now_en: 首个145B本地模型今日开源
items.summary_en: Edge0 has open-sourced the Edge0-145B model, a 145-billion-parameter AI system designed to run locally on personal computers with 48GB of memory, achieving 80+ tokens/s speed and 29GB peak memory usage by utilizing a sparse expert architecture and CPU/GPU cooperative scheduling. The model outperforms or matches frontier cloud models on key benchmarks, scoring 64.6 on DeepSWE 1.1 (surpassing Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's 58.7) and 86.52 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, while maintaining a 62.8% lower memory footprint compared to the 70GB estimated deployment of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. By integrating a unified inference framework and deployment tools, Edge0-145B enables complex local agent workflows, such as autonomous coding and video generation, without incurring cloud API fees or relying on external network connectivity.

items.title: llm-gemini 0.37
items.summary: 谷歌推出 Gemini 4 家族中最低成本的 Hydrogen 模型，其输入/输出价格定为 $1.50/$7.50 每百万 token，仅为同类顶级模型 Carbon 和 Argon 的 75% 折扣力度。尽管官方称其能作为独立执行引擎或与其他模型协同工作，但相比 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 GPT-6 Luna 的 $0.10/$0.50 低价策略，Hydrogen 价格高出 15 倍，且在图像生成等实测任务中，其表现与价格更高的 Carbon/Argon 存在显著差距。
items.why_now: 12月1日Gemini 4 Carbon和Argon价格翻倍，Hydrogen将成免费层且性价比凸显，需趁调价前锁定API。
items.why_now_en: Gemini 4 Carbon/Argon prices double Dec 1; lock in now.
items.summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, positioning it as the low-cost execution model for everyday coding tasks and AI features in Google Search, with pricing of $1.50/M input and $7.50/M output that will become a 75% discount relative to the family after the December 1 price hike. Unlike the similarly priced Carbon and Argon, which double in cost next year, Hydrogen remains the entry-point tier, though it is still 15x more expensive than competitors like Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna ($0.10/$0.50).

items.title: 谷歌发布首个决策模型！输出全免费，百万Token低至0.1美元
items.summary: 谷歌正式发布多模态决策模型 Gemini Decision 1 及配套 API，支持在一次前向传递中处理高达 256K Token 的多模态数据并并发回答 1000 个问题，输入成本低至 0.10 美元/百万 Token 且输出完全免费，较竞品 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 便宜近 5 倍。该模型提供“是/否”、“最高 255 选项的多项选择”及“精准打分”三种原生决策模式，通过降低校准误差和将端到端延迟压缩至 150-250 毫秒，在智能体路由和模型动态等基准测试中表现领先，旨在替代传统自定义分类器以解决复杂场景下的快速决策需求。
items.why_now: 谷歌Gemini Decision 1 API上线，百万输入Token仅0.1美元且输出免费，抢17天巨头混战窗口。

items.title: Coding agent写测试集体失败！AI代码合格率被高估一倍
items.summary: 南京大学刘佳恒团队提出测试生成新基准 TestPrism，通过引入包含正确与错误替代实现的多源面板及联合成功函数（JSF）指标，发现当前最强 Coding Agent 在单一参考评测中 59.67% 的通过率被高估，实际仅 28.00% 的测试能可靠区分所有实现。该研究进一步提出 TestHelix 框架，利用异构合成与交叉验证技术在相同推理预算下将 JSF 提升 11.67 至 12.00 个百分点，揭示了现有评测体系对实现变体鲁棒性的缺失。

items.title: 多模态“源神”！MiniMax开源SOTA生图模型，原生4K，一张两毛
items.why_now_en: MiniMax open-sourced SOTA 4K model with first-week API 50% discount.
items.summary_en: MiniMax has open-sourced H3-Image, a SOTA multimodal model capable of native 4K (4096x4096) generation with a cost of approximately 0.2 RMB per image, or 50-70% the price of competitors via API. The model supports up to 16 reference images and demonstrates advanced spatial reasoning, accurately generating CAD orthographic views, mechanical exploded diagrams, and complex mathematical layouts. Its ability to produce realistic human details and maintain strong aesthetic quality positions it as a viable alternative to text-based coding agents for vertical tasks like industrial design and commercial asset creation.

items.title: Artificial Analysis 评测 Gemini 4 Hydrogen：智能指数 54，接近 Sonnet 5.5 且成本约其 32%
items.why_now_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen with 32% cost vs. Sonnet.
items.summary_en: Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model achieves an Intelligence Index score of 54 with its new xhigh reasoning tier, trailing Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max) and GPT-6.1 Sol (max) by one point while offering a cost per task that is 32% of Sonnet's but 2.5 times GPT-6.1 Sol's. The model, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million input/output tokens with a 1-million-token context window, excels in visual reasoning and hallucination resistance (8% rate on AA-Omniscience) but underperforms on agent terminal tasks, scoring 54% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 compared to Claude's 64%.

items.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
items.summary: 该开源项目利用 AkShare、Tushare 等数据源及 GPT、Claude 等 LLM，构建覆盖 A 股、港股、美股等市场的智能分析系统，可生成包含买卖点位、风险警报及操作清单的“决策仪表盘”。用户仅需 Fork 仓库并配置 API 密钥与自选股代码，即可通过 GitHub Actions 实现零成本定时运行，并自动将分析结果推送至企业微信、飞书或 Telegram 等渠道，支持 15 种内置 Agent 策略的多轮交互式问股。

items.title: shadcn/improve
items.summary: shadcn/improve 是一款基于“高能力模型审计、低成本模型执行”策略的 Agent 技能，通过生成自包含的 Markdown 实施计划来优化代码库。用户通过 `npx skills add shadcn/improve` 安装后，使用 `/improve` 命令可针对安全性、性能等九个类别进行并行子代理审计，利用 `/improve execute` 在隔离工作树中调度更便宜的模型实施具体修复方案。
items.why_now: 刚发布npx一键安装命令，让你即刻用便宜模型执行审计，大幅降低一人公司开发成本。

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
items.summary: agent-browser 是一个基于 Rust 开发的 CLI 工具，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 让 AI 代理以单命令驱动浏览器，其核心机制是将页面转换为带引用标识（如 @e1）的可访问性树，支持代理循环执行快照、交互与结果校验。该工具默认使用 Chrome for Testing，兼容 CDP 模式及 Lightpanda 等引擎，并可通过 `agent-browser skills get core` 加载动态更新的技能包，或集成至 AGENTS.md 供 MCP 客户端调用，确保代理指令始终与 CLI 版本同步。
items.why_now: Vercel 开源 agent-browser，让 AI 代理通过 Shell 命令直接驱动浏览器，大幅降低自动化门槛。

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary: addyosmani/agent-skills 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的开源工程技能包，包含 25 项编码实践和 9 个覆盖“定义、计划、构建、验证、审查、发布”全生命周期的斜杠命令，支持通过 `npx skills` CLI 一键集成到 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 70 多种主流 AI 代理中。该工具通过强制执行测试驱动开发、性能审计和代码简化等标准工作流，使 AI 代理能够像资深工程师一样稳定输出生产级代码，并提供 `/build` 自动模式在单次批准计划后自主执行任务。
items.why_now: Addy Osmani 发布标准化技能包，可一键部署至 70 多种 AI 编程代理，立即补齐工程化短板。

items.title: My cheap coding plan ran out in 20 days, and cost more per merged change than GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: 小米MiMo Token Plan Pro月费¥329（380亿积分）在20天内耗尽，单次通过变更成本约$0.81，且首次通过评审率仅16%，平均耗时35.6分钟；相比之下，GPT-6.1 Sol以$0.71的单次成本实现了71%的首次通过率，且平均耗时仅4.2分钟。此外，MiMo套餐相比按量计费仅便宜13%，而用户自记账因未包含子代理用量导致实际消耗被低估2.6倍。
items.why_now: 小米MiMo套餐20天耗尽且单次通过率低，性价比反不如GPT-6.1 Sol。

items.title: Show HN: Bricksentry – see what a data change does before it ships (Databricks)
items.summary: Bricksentry是一款基于Apache-2.0协议开源的Databricks管道安全校验工具，能在数据变更上线前通过克隆对比识别如重复键、数据丢失等风险，并自动生成回滚（RESTORE）指令。其支持通过GitHub Actions拦截拉取请求，或利用MCP服务器为AI代理提供相同的变更检查能力，确保自动化修改的安全。用户可在一分钟内通过Databricks Bundle部署无服务器任务，实现对指定表的实时变更审计、阻断下游失败任务及发送Slack告警。
items.why_now_en: Open-source MCP server for Databricks lands as agents start writing SQL.
items.summary_en: Bricksentry, an open-source tool under the Apache-2.0 license, provides pre-deployment safety checks for Databricks pipelines by analyzing data changes in local DuckDB or serverless environments to detect issues like duplicate keys before they ship. It integrates into workflows via Databricks bundle commands, GitHub Actions, and an MCP server, allowing AI agents to preview changes on shallow clones and blocking bad commits with a RESTORE command. Users can deploy a monitoring job in under two minutes using a single CLI command that triggers checks on table updates, logs corrective actions, and optionally sends Slack alerts.

items.title: Show HN: AgentLeak – open-source privacy testing for multi-agent LLM systems
items.why_now_en: Multi-agent stacks leak 74% of secrets via logs, not final outputs.
items.summary_en: AgentLeak is an open-source benchmark and Python tool for detecting privacy leaks in multi-agent LLM systems across seven internal and external channels, including tool calls, shared memory, and logs. Based on an IEEE Access paper evaluating 4,979 validated traces across five models, the system reveals that internal channels leak 2.6 times more sensitive data than external outputs, with tool inputs and logs exhibiting leakage rates up to 85% even when final outputs are sanitized. The platform supports integration with frameworks like CrewAI and LangChain, and its core trace analysis runs locally without requiring an LLM dependency.

items.title: 黄仁勋宣布辞职，特朗普：库克适合接任；微信「看一看」测试短剧入口；《GTA 6》还没发售就狂卖近千万份｜极客早知道
items.summary: 11月12日，英伟达创始人黄仁勋辞去CEO职务，股价应声下跌13%，同期谷歌发布主打快速编程的Gemini 4 Hydrogen模型，其在Terminal-Bench 4.1测试中得分达57%，速度较Gemini 3.8 Flash提升2.5倍。字节跳动推出视频生成模型Seedance 2.5 flash，生成速度翻倍且720P视频单价降至0.99元/秒，降幅约34%。此外，美国拟扩大AI芯片出口管制以限制中企获取算力，而二手交易平台转转已秘密提交港交所IPO申请，拟募资5亿美元。

items.title: meta/astryx
items.why_now_en: Meta open-sourced Astryx, their in-house agent-ready design system.
items.summary_en: Meta Astryx is an open-source React 19+ design system that powers over 13,000 internal apps, shipping 150+ accessible components, seven themes, and a CLI built for both human and AI agent workflows. It eliminates styling lock-in by using StyleX internally while allowing overrides via Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS, and offers a "swizzle" feature to eject component source code for full customization.

items.title: AI Shopping Errors: What To Fix To Help Shoppers Choose Your Products
items.why_now: Adobe预测AI流量今假日季暴增130%，商家须即刻修复数据以防流量流失。
items.summary_en: The AI shopping landscape is shifting toward direct commerce, with Adobe forecasting a 130% increase in holiday traffic to US retail sites and OpenAI expanding its Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) to enable in-chat checkout for merchants like Target and Best Buy. Meanwhile, Google is leveraging its Shopping Graph, which holds over 50 billion product listings, to power agentic checkout via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) in AI Overviews and Gemini. Brands must audit their product data to prevent common errors—such as outdated prices, incorrect SKU recommendations, and misplaced merchant links—that currently divert shoppers to competitors or resellers.

items.title: Does The Affiliate Model Survive Checkout Inside AI Mode And Gemini? – Ask An SEO via @sejournal, @rollerblader
items.why_now: Google UCP已支持AI内结账，联盟营销需即刻重构追踪与变现策略。
items.why_now_en: Google's UCP checkout inside Gemini now intercepts affiliate clicks.
items.summary_en: Google's Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) allows checkout directly within AI Mode and Gemini, bypassing traditional affiliate links, but affiliate marketing remains viable through cross-device tracking, server-to-server synchronization, and IP hashing techniques that attribute sales without direct link clicks. Affiliates should diversify revenue beyond single-link monetization by securing partnerships that offer multiple tracking methods, such as vanity codes and third-party platform integrations (e.g., TikTok Shop), to ensure commissions are captured even when shoppers complete purchases inside closed ecosystems.

items.title: The Verge 分析黄仁勋辞职与 Nvidia 芯片走私疑云
items.summary: NVIDIA 宣布 CEO 黄仁勋辞职，CFO Colette Kress 出任临时 CEO，此举被视为董事会借婚外情传闻将公司与其切割，以应对更深层的芯片走私指控。文章揭示黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍的女性存在关联，牵涉新云公司 Megaspeed 及 Super Micro 等渠道，其中 Super Micro 相关人员被控协助阿里巴巴非法采购价值 25 亿美元的英伟达芯片；做空机构 Culper Research 更指控英伟达 2026 财年超过 20% 的算力收入通过东南亚中间商非法流向中国，与黄仁勋声称“中国市场份额为零”的说法形成巨大反差。
items.why_now: 黄仁勋已辞职，芯片走私丑闻或致Nvidia监管风险激增，窗口期关键。

items.title: AI’s biggest CEO may be on his way out
items.summary: 英伟达董事会正据报准备撤换CEO黄仁勋，此前其涉及两起不雅传闻，导致公司市值单日蒸发超过4270亿美元，这一变动对作为全球AI芯片核心供应商的英伟达构成重大冲击。同时，Claude Projects新增自动保存知识文件功能，允许用户在网页端跨设备共享包含组织工作逻辑的项目上下文，解决了此前仅能在本地实现持续记忆与团队协作的技术限制。

items.title: 250名三甲医生输给中国AI！引发中美医疗权威热议
items.summary: 未来医生医疗大模型MedGPT在40例真实疑难肺癌病例评测中取得85.29分，超越250名三甲医生的53.26平均分，在750份方案一对一比较中以88:12胜出，且得分显著高于GPT-5.4（71.38分）、Claude Opus 4.7（61.81分）和Gemini 3.1 Pro（54.62分）。其核心优势并非底层模型参数，而在于构建了包含800万条最小颗粒度证据单元的知识网络，并通过多学科AI智能体协作、动态患者状态档案及对抗式审查流程实现诊疗方案的自动验证与优化。该系统通过辅助将医生的综合决策评分从53.4提升至66.27，相对提高24.1%，证明其价值在于增强而非替代医生的临床判断。

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after admitting to multiple extramarital affairs, including one with VP Kimberly Powell and another unnamed employee, leading to interim CEO Colette Kress assuming leadership and former Synopsys chief Harvey C. Jones becoming the company’s first board chair. The scandal centers on suspicions that Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, a likely romantic interest of Jensen Huang, is a Chinese spy linked to the Singapore-based firm’s purchase of $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips, prompting a U.S. Justice Department investigation into potential national security breaches.

items.title: 穿了 33 年皮衣的那个人，离开了英伟达
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO and board member after 33 years on November 12, with CFO Colette Kress appointed as interim CEO following allegations of extramarital affairs and a suspected foreign intelligence link to a Singaporean data center executive. Nvidia's stock dropped 10% in pre-market trading after the announcement, amid analyst concerns that the lack of a succession plan and the potential departure of its founder could significantly impact the company's AI chip roadmap and valuation.

items.title: "Humble Bundle just killed most of their security through vibecoding"
items.summary: Humble Bundle 因使用 AI “vibecoding” 方式开发代码，导致其安全机制严重受损，暴露出大量漏洞。该事件在 Hacker News 上获得 371 分及 221 条评论，引发了对生成式 AI 编程在安全关键领域应用风险的广泛讨论。
items.summary_en: Humble Bundle suffered a major security breach after using an LLM-based "vibe-coding" tool to generate authentication code, which failed to properly handle edge cases such as expired or malformed tokens. The vulnerability allowed attackers to bypass the identity verification system and exploit unauthorized API access, demonstrating the critical security risks of deploying AI-generated code without rigorous human review and testing.

items.title: SemiAnalysis 分析黄仁勋辞任 Nvidia CEO 背后的出口管制博弈
items.summary: SemiAnalysis 数据追踪显示，超过 1.5GW 的受限英伟达芯片通过走私流入中国，这一背景与黄仁勋辞任 CEO 及美国情报界推动的 RASA 法案密切相关，旨在收紧对中国的 GPU 远程访问限制。在组织架构上，黄仁勋曾以约 60 名直接下属的扁平化管理模式掌舵英伟达 33 年，该模式缺乏深厚的接班人选储备，目前由科莱特·克雷斯临时接任，而具备 CUDA 起源背景的伊恩·巴克和负责 GPU 设计的乔纳·阿尔本虽是内部人选，但均难以复制其供应链掌控力与“造王”能力。财务层面，英伟达截至第二财季的表外担保总额激增至 5300 亿美元（上季为 1840 亿美元），其中包含 360 亿美元的照付不议保底和 990 亿美元的股权账面价值，这种依赖创始人个人信用的“兜底”模式在黄仁勋离任后面临巨大不确定性。
items.summary_en: SemiAnalysis asserts that Jensen Huang's abrupt departure as Nvidia CEO was driven by US intelligence pushing the RASA bill against remote GPU access for China, with Nvidia's internal data revealing that over 1.5 GW of restricted chips were smuggled into China. The analysis projects that the loss of Huang, who centralized control over 60 direct reports, undermines Nvidia's unique founder-led culture and its "Nvidia Central Bank" strategy, which utilized $53 billion in off-balance sheet guarantees to sustain neoclouds and secure supply chain monopolies. Key internal successors like Ian Buck and Jonah Alben lack the strategic leverage to maintain these bold, multi-year bets on CUDA, Omniverse, and autonomous vehicles compared to the outgoing CEO.

items.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.summary_en: Nebius announced a $40 billion spending plan for 2027, financed primarily through customer pre-payments and loans backed by data center contracts. This strategy faces significant risk as delays at its Vineland, New Jersey site, operated by DataOne, have pushed delivery of a $19.4 billion Microsoft contract to Q2 2027, triggering regulatory fines and lawsuits while prompting Microsoft to tighten oversight of third-party vendors.

items.title: Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund
items.summary_en: Norwest, a Wells Fargo-backed investment firm, has raised its largest fund to date—a $4 billion 18th fund—explicitly focused on expanding its AI portfolio across the US, India, and Israel. The fund targets a broad range of AI opportunities including physical AI, voice AI, agentic cybersecurity, and aerospace, with a specific emphasis on early-stage AI-native applications and infrastructure. Recent investments under this strategy include Coval, which tests and evaluates AI agents, and Generalist AI, a developer of AI foundation models for robots, following a streak of more than 87 deals since its previous $3 billion raise in 2024.

items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO immediately
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned immediately following a board meeting convened to address reports of a personal affair. The resignation was announced on November 12, 2026, with the company’s leadership transition becoming the subject of public discussion on Hacker News.

items.title: 从通用大模型到学习过程智能，AI如何真正进入课堂？
items.summary: 字节跳动原副总裁陈林创立的银河智学推出“小鹿爱学”，采用豆包大模型与自研智能学习引擎（融合DKT、IRT、CDM、KST技术）的双核架构，通过苏格拉底式启发和预测70%-80%答对概率的任务匹配，实现规模化因材施教。该产品已落地超过500所学校，覆盖24个省级行政区，通过构建包含学情看板与AI批改的人机共育教学闭环，将AI从单点问答工具升级为深入学校日常课程组织与教学反馈的完整解决方案。
